title: Planner: task hierarchy (nested tasks) in unified plans
summary: The briefing needs a small licensing correction before publication: task hierarchy is not limited to Planner Plan 1 and Planner and Project Plan 3, because existing Plan 5 subscriptions include Plan 3 capabilities. The roadmap details, licence-assignment controls and Planner PowerShell calls are supported; unified-plan licensing and the rollout default remain unpublished.

claims.claim: Tasks sit in plans whose container membership determines who can see the plan's contents.
claims.quote: Within Planner, each Plan is inside a container, and access to the plan is defined by the container. For example, if the Plan is inside a Modern Group, then the members of the Group can see the contents of the Plan.
